verdict.rationale: The pack never documents how flag changes reach connected SDKs: no streaming or real-time updates, no polling interval, and no propagation-latency figures. The "kill switch" line (docs-50) and remote toggling (gh-1) describe a dashboard capability, not delivery speed to SDKs. Edge Proxy "low latency" is about serving requests, not propagating changes, so these are adjacent features only.

support.subject: As a developer, flag changes propagate to connected SDKs in seconds via streaming or fast polling — a kill switch actually kills
